name: NeodraDynamics
summary: NeodraDynamics is a Beijing robotics company developing hydraulic-electric drive systems and heavy-duty humanoid robots. Its portfolio combines digital hydraulic actuators, dexterous hands and humanoid arms for physically demanding industrial and hazardous-environment tasks. The company presented its Neo1 humanoid at the 2026 World Robot Conference. Its products target applications such as heavy assembly, material handling, mining and emergency response; these are manufacturer-described applications rather than independently verified deployments.
